sites.name: Connecting Ridge
sites.description: Ridge linking Shackleton and de Gerlache craters; some of the best-lit terrain at the pole.
sites.source: Gracy & Lee 2024, LPSC 55, abstract 1695 (candidate site in NASA Artemis III region)

sites.name: Peak Near Shackleton
sites.description: Elevated peak beside Shackleton crater, close to its permanently shadowed floor.
sites.source: Gracy & Lee 2024, LPSC 55, abstract 1695 (candidate site in NASA Artemis III region)

sites.name: Malapert Massif
sites.description: Tall massif facing Earth: near-constant direct-to-Earth contact, but real lunar nights.
sites.source: Local summit (4993 m) found in the Moon Trek 30 m LOLA DEM within 4 km of the commonly quoted Malapert Mountain point (-85.99, 357.07). That point sits on the flank: a ridge 100 m north blocks Earth 100% of the time; the summit sees Earth 99.9%.

sites.name: de Gerlache Rim (approx.)
sites.description: Rim of de Gerlache crater, next to a large PSR.
sites.source: Approximate point in NASA's Artemis III candidate region of this name (estimate used by the rescue catalog, accurate to ~0.1-0.5 deg). Not a published landing point.
